message.text:
I need to find every RPC method in ShortcutService and identify the backend file that implements each one.

Searching proto files for the ShortcutService definition and backend implementations.

Business logic for ShortcutService RPCs is implemented in shortcut_service.go.

connect_services.go merely delegates to APIV1Service. No other backend file implements these RPCs.

All five RPCs are implemented in `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go`.

`connect_services.go` contains thin wrappers that delegate to the implementation.

q14.

**RPCs:** ListShortcuts, GetShortcut, CreateShortcut, UpdateShortcut, DeleteShortcut  

**Implementing file:** `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go`

All five are declared on `ShortcutService` in `proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto`. Their handlers are `APIV1Service` methods in `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go`:

| RPC | Handler |
|---|---|
| ListShortcuts | `APIV1Service.ListShortcuts` (line 49) |
| GetShortcut | `APIV1Service.GetShortcut` (line 95) |
| CreateShortcut | `APIV1Service.CreateShortcut` (line 135) |
| UpdateShortcut | `APIV1Service.UpdateShortcut` (line 211) |
| DeleteShortcut | `APIV1Service.DeleteShortcut` (line 284) |

`ConnectServiceHandler` methods in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` (lines 528–565) only delegate to those `APIV1Service` methods and do not contain the implementation logic.
